name: readme-install-front-loading
body: README.md's Install section front-loads the package-manager channels: immediately under the Install heading, Homebrew (macOS: `brew tap really-knows-ai/kalide https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` + `brew install kalide`) and Scoop (Windows: `scoop bucket add kalide https://github.com/really-knows-ai/kalide` + `scoop install kalide`) appear first as copy-pasteable command blocks, each with its upgrade command. Only after them comes manual download from GitHub Releases, presented as the Linux route and as a fallback for macOS/Windows. The section links to INSTALL.md for the detailed guide and mentions no token, account or repo-access step. AC: in README.md's Install section the Homebrew and Scoop command blocks precede any manual-download instructions; manual download is labelled as the Linux / fallback route; a link to INSTALL.md is present; the section contains no occurrence of "token", `HOMEBREW_GITHUB_API_TOKEN`, `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN` or "repo access".
